name: dolibarr
title: Dolibarr
description: Search companies and contacts in Dolibarr and review their proposals and invoices
author: baxter

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search
commands.subtitle: Dolibarr
commands.description: Find companies and contacts in Dolibarr

commands.name: check-connection
commands.title: Check Connection
commands.subtitle: Dolibarr
commands.description: Verify the Dolibarr URL and API key against the instance

tools.name: search-dolibarr
tools.title: Search Dolibarr
tools.description: Searches companies and contacts in Dolibarr by name, email address or phone number.

tools.name: company-overview
tools.title: Dolibarr Company Overview
tools.description: Returns a company's master data, its proposals, orders and invoices, and totals for open and overdue amounts.

tools.name: recent-documents
tools.title: Recent Dolibarr Documents
tools.description: Lists the most recent proposals, orders or invoices across all customers, newest first. Answers questions like "what are the latest orders?".

tools.name: open-items
tools.title: Dolibarr Open Items
tools.description: Everything that needs following up across all customers: overdue invoices, expired proposals and delivered orders that have not been invoiced yet.

preferences.name: dolibarrUrl
preferences.title: Dolibarr URL
preferences.description: Address of the Dolibarr instance, for example https://dolibarr.example.org

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API key
preferences.description: Found in Dolibarr on your own user card under the API key tab

preferences.name: displayLocale
preferences.title: Number and Date Format
preferences.description: How amounts and dates are displayed. The interface language stays English.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
